question.text: How is the premium for exchange-traded interest rate options settled?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that ETIRD daily and final settlement are on T+1 working day, and that premium settlement is effected before market hours on the next day (i.e., T+1). The Trap: T+0 and T+2 are common settlement cycles in other markets and are distractors here. "On expiry date only" confuses premium settlement with final cash settlement. Note: Because premium is settled on T+1, an option buyer needs the premium funds available by the next business day after the trade.
